---
title: "Proteomics preprocessing"
author: "Homa Bazireh"
output: html_document
---

This executable core is extracted from the original notebook with the same
filename. It selects FF4, replaces protein values at or outside the IQR fences
with the feature median, retains the identifier and protein columns, and drops
incomplete rows. It expects the original provider export layout and its upstream
transformations. It does not add a log or z transformation.

Run from the repository root using `scripts/run_analysis.R`, or run
`Rscript scripts/preprocess_omics.R proteomics`. All inputs and outputs stay
under the external directory specified by `KORA_PRIVATE_DIR`.

```{r preprocessing}
source(file.path(Sys.getenv("KORA_CODE_DIR"), "scripts", "preprocess_omics.R"))
run_preprocessing("proteomics")
```

Private outputs are `processed/Scaled.log.Trans.Proteomics.RData` and
`processed/Scaled.log.Trans.Proteomics.csv`. The RData object is named
`Scaled.log.Trans.Proteomics`. Diagnostic plots and unrelated exploratory
sections of the original working notebook are not executed by this core.
